collection.title: Jaguar XJ XJS 1975 to 1999 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Jaguar XJS 1975 - 1999 model requires a 15" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is also the option to upgrade to the newer Retrofit style wiper blades.
